Manifest.Name: 要不要进货 Inventory Category Stats
Manifest.Author: Oniisama
Manifest.Description:
在柜台电话下沿贴一张便签。点开后按游戏标签做物品分类统计、库存管理：每行一个品类和颜色，全部赃物和全部违禁品只显示一个对应颜色的件数。其他标签写成（普通/赃物/违禁品），赃物和违禁品用各自的颜色。后面是这一行的基础价值总和。悬停高亮对应库存，点击锁定后不再跟着别的标签变。用来看品类记录、标签记录和价值，决定要不要进货。
便签右上角的扳手打开游戏内设置，改完立刻生效。 便签开着时，件数和基础价值会跟着库存变，按每一叠的数量计。可以查看每个标签的物品价值总和。 缩放档位和拖动位置都会记住。分辨率变了以后，便签仍会留在画面里。
基础 - 便签纸摆放方位：左边（电话下沿，默认）或右边（平板电脑右下方） - 跳过上锁容器里的货（默认开启） - 跳过杂物堆（默认开启） - 排除项仍计入赃物和违禁品（默认开启） - 描边粗细：1 到 6，默认最细 - 库存刷新间隔：0.2 到 2 秒，默认 0.4 秒
显示类型 赃物、违禁品和基础类型默认显示。 细分类型和未归类默认不显示。 勾选的类型都会出现在便签上，没有库存也显示 0。
排除标签 勾选的细分标签整件不计入品类，也不描边。
排除物品 可搜索并勾选。净水药片默认排除，其余默认不排除。
被排除的货默认仍计入全部赃物和全部违禁品，悬停这两行时也会描边。
A sticky note sits under the counter phone. Open it for a tally by the game's own tags: each row shows a category, its color, All stolen and All contraband show one count in their own color. Other tags are written as (normal/stolen/contraband), with stolen and contraband colored, followed by the total base value of that row. Hover a row to outline that stock; click to lock the highlight so it stays put when you look at another tag. Use it to read the category records, tag records, and values, and decide whether to restock.
The wrench at the top right of the note opens the in-game settings. Changes apply immediately. While the note stays open, counts and base values follow the stock and include the size of each stack. You can see the total value of the items under each tag. Zoom and drag position are remembered. If the resolution changes, the note stays on screen.
General - Note side: left, under the phone (default), or right, below and beside the tablet - Skip goods inside locked containers (on by default) - Skip debris (on by default) - Still count excluded goods as stolen and contraband (on by default) - Outline thickness: 1 to 6, thinnest by default - Stock refresh interval: 0.2 to 2 seconds, 0.4 by default
Show types Stolen goods, contraband, and the main types are shown by default. Detail types and Uncategorized stay off. Every checked type appears on the note, including a count of 0.
Exclude tags A checked detail tag drops the whole item from category rows and outlines.
Exclude items Search and check items. Water purification tablets are excluded by default. Everything else stays included.
Excluded goods still count toward All stolen and All contraband by default, and they outline when those rows are hovered.
